method: hurdle: P(bought) logistic (L2, C=0.03, features: + prior market price); ln(price / purse | bought) tobit regression (alpha=0.3, standardised features, refolded to raw units; recipe 'S without the quadratic value term', chosen by leave one auction out on auctions <= 2024); calibration isotonic-tail+group-median-offset on out-of-fold predictions (groups: overseas_mega, overseas_mini, capped_indian, uncapped_indian)

protocol.selection: leave one auction out over 2019-2024, auctions <= 2024 only; lowest mean absolute ln error on the lots wins
protocol.test: fitted <= 2024, scored on 2025 mega + 2026 mini, once, for the chosen recipe (and the previous one, for reference)

evaluation.chosen: T  S without the quadratic value term
